code_review_findings.summary: [P2] Route an already-created offline PA to its existing configuration
code_review_findings.failure_scenario: Create a PA, then take its owning computer offline or let its personal runtime report unavailable. The server projects its active stored binding as status=unavailable while creation remains null. The new chat menu routes only status=active to /settings/agents/:id, so this already-created PA instead opens the reduced setup dialog. That dialog has no settings or restore branch and no creation receipt to recover, leaving only its not-ready message and Done. This breaks the unified configuration entry exactly when the owner may need the moved restore controls. Distinguish unfinished creation using the creation receipt, not runtime availability. Add an unavailable+creation=null chat-menu case alongside the active case.

code_review_findings.summary: [P2] Protect unsaved shared configuration before moving the PA to another computer
code_review_findings.failure_scenario: In the initial R14 candidate, edit the name or custom instructions without saving, then choose another online computer in the new same-page PA card and restore. Restore uses the persisted profile, then invalidates ['settings','agents',agentId]. The parent AgentDetailPage refetches detail-state, observes changed node_id/profile metadata, and its existing useEffect calls setDraft(config), silently replacing the unsaved form. The initial card neither receives the parent's dirty state nor prevents this operation. Reuse the parent isDirty/applyPending/mutation.isPending state to disable migration with a save/discard explanation, then refresh after a permitted restore. Caller has already added this guard during review; it is retained here as the confirmed initial finding pending the requested correction-batch verification, not a claim that the current guard is absent.
